faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about AI Video Generator

items.question: What generation modes does the video generator support?
items.answer: We support three modes: Text-to-Video (generate from a text prompt), Image-to-Video (animate a reference image), and Video-to-Video (transform an existing video using a reference URL).

items.question: What is the maximum video length?
items.answer: Generated videos are typically 5–10 seconds long, depending on the model selected. Longer durations may require more credits.

items.question: What resolutions are supported?
items.answer: Supported resolutions vary by model and include 720p and 1080p options with common aspect ratios such as 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1.

items.question: How long does video generation take?
items.answer: Video generation usually takes 1–5 minutes depending on length, resolution, and current load. Progress is displayed in real time.

items.question: How many credits does a video cost?
items.answer: Credits consumed depend on the model and output length. You can see the estimated cost before you start generation.

items.question: Can I use generated videos commercially?
items.answer: Yes, subject to our Terms of Service and the model's usage policies. Review the applicable terms before publishing commercial content.
